ASX closed lower on rate-hike fears; Buffett-style 'one thing' discipline; rate environment favours fixed income

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure over 1–3 months as RBA rate-hike expectations persist, housing data deteriorates, and oil-driven inflation keeps the RBA hawkish. Small-cap miners and energy names may outperform; REITs and construction lag. QAN.AX faces near-term operational overhang.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook is cautiously constructive ('bull case returns') if rate cycle peaks and housing stabilises. Structural themes: EV transition, AI/defence capex, critical minerals, and gold. Iron ore oversupply is a medium-term headwind for BHP/RIO. Construction sector needs a reset. Victoria debt and ASIC regulatory actions add overhangs.
